The '''stabilizing coil''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] part. In [[140 ABY]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] engineer [[Sauk]] purchased a retrofitted stabilizing coil from [[Jariah Syn]], a companion of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Deliah Blue]]. While Sauk was reluctant to pay a high amount to Syn, he paid in the end since it was very hard to obtain spare parts in this star system. Sauk's purchase came at an opportune moment because he and his companions were then attacked.
